result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 #[tool_handler] preserves user-supplied ServerHandler methods and only synthesizes call_tool/list_tools/get_tool/get_info when absent. A persistent-task adapter can therefore keep macro-generated router-first call_tool, provide custom get_task/update_task/cancel_task methods that delegate to application-owned storage, and provide a custom task-advertising get_info. Central Service<RoleServer> dispatch capability-gates the three task RPCs before calling those overrides; this seam does not require stock TaskManager.
